name: dealer-ai-sentiment-monitor
description: Audit how AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Claude, Copilot, optional Grok) describe and characterize a car dealership. 6-dimension, 100-point framework covering tone, factual accuracy, strength framing, concern framing, competitive positioning, and hallucination plus stale-data risk. Includes 25-prompt English standard set plus 4-prompt Spanish set for bilingual markets. Each prompt run 3 times per engine for non-determinism. Produces per-engine breakdown, cross-engine score, hallucinations table with severity classification, competitive framing remediation map, and monitoring cadence. Distinct from dealer-customer-sentiment-analyzer (Google reviews) and dealer-ai-visibility (citation presence). Closes the OnPrompt brand sentiment feature.
